review pipeline\\u0027s stage composition and per-stage models become configuration, recorded per run, with an Adjudicate findings-triage stage as its first optional addition (Brian, 2026-09-01, folding two explorations into one idea). Motivation: experiment the way #94/#106 taught - one variable at a time, revert on measurement - but as config changes instead of code changes, dialing in token, model, and time efficiency per project. What exists already and is NOT this idea: per-role models for review, fix, and verify (#33, #82, #105) settable at node/project/task; cycle caps and the lifetime budget (e5c0d371, landing). What is genuinely new: (1) stage toggles - build with no review at all, adversarial-only, conformance-only, skip the final full pass - composed per project or task; (2) the one missing model knob, a separately configurable final-full-pass model; (3) the Adjudicate stage: a short-lived fresh-context pass on the strongest model, slotted between a review verdict and the fix dispatch, ruling each finding in, out, or park-for-human on the merits, reading the findings and their cited lines only, NEVER the branch diff (the #94 packet lesson; the 576M-token day is what diff-scoped passes cost). Field support for Adjudicate: findings-triage filter agents are among the better-replicated results in multi-agent review (an SAST filter agent measured 88.6 percent false-positive reduction at 3.1 percent recall cost; a commercial micro-agent system reports 51 percent). Two design requirements from our own scars: every run records the stage configuration it ran under (the stranding investigation took three rounds because nothing on the stream said which prompt a session ran - experiments are unreadable without provenance), and defaults stay the full pipeline with load-bearing guarantees (#92, #98) removable only with the consequence said out loud at set time - the platform advises, never refuses, same doctrine as idea fcaded0b. Measurement gates before building Adjudicate: (a) the store already holds ground-truth labels for the false-finding rate - every human park ruling is one (dismissed merge-ready means a wasted lap was coming; upheld needs-fixes means the reviewer was right) - so measure that rate first and only build if it clears the breakeven (a scoped arbiter pass costs a small fraction of the fix-session-plus-verify-lap-plus-gate a bogus Medium costs); (b) judge against the post-d74c353d baseline, since the final-pass fix bar removes the largest measured slice of wasted laps already; (c) Adjudicate ships with a pre-committed revert condition, because 93 percent of finding locations appear in exactly one run, so a wrongly discarded finding is likely never rediscovered. Explicitly rejected during exploration: keeping reviewer agents resident for live dialogue with the fix agent - the field\\u0027s own design requirement is context asymmetry (a critic inheriting the builder\\u0027s context defeats independence), hall9k\\u0027s fresh-context-per-cycle doctrine says the same, and the findings and fix-position artifacts already carry the dialogue (dispute parks are the fix session challenging the reviewer today).
